g.text: EAST REAR WIDTH: 21′-6″ printed · CONCEPT HOUSE: 6.30 × 10.10 m (≈ 63.63 m²)
2 bedrooms (one compact), attached bath, kitchen, stairs, living & circulation.
No water tank, septic tank or soak pit shown in V004. West/road setback only.
PDF trace is NOT a cadastral survey; local bearings, approvals and statutory clearances remain on hold.
